t: I Don't Know What to Do Sometimes
s: The author reflects on past tech trends, regrets, and the evolving landscape of web development, finding renewed purpose in writing and utilizing tools like Nix for efficient static site generation.
sub: Impact of SPAs on SEO and early AJAX adoption
Personal reflection on missed opportunities and love for retro tech (Nix, Amiga)
The WET movement vs. DRY, and writing as self-expression
Nix for automating Jekyll site deployment and live-reloading
Ethical considerations of AI live-reloading and transhuman empathy
